$comment: Drafted from design-repo/templates/routes.json (observed section order per route) and design-repo/sections/*.json (one description per section). Templates are split by real composition: a design-repo template whose member routes carry different section sets becomes one IA template per distinct set, linked back by 'family'. Repeated sections on one page (e.g. four feature.split rows) are listed once, at first occurrence. Edit this file by hand from now on; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated. implementedBy names the component rendering the section's first/primary instance; alsoImplementedBy lists other components rendering the same section elsewhere (page-local copies, wrappers). Every name was grep-verified as a definition in that file.

meta.title: hex.tech clone — information architecture
meta.source: Local React clone of https://hex.tech/ (this folder); route table src/routes.jsx
meta.routeNotes: Counts include the '*' catch-all (placeholder page). Not counted: 2 redirects (/product/integrations/athena/, /product/integrations/redshift/ -> /product/integrations/aws/) and 2 dev-only routes (/__theme-test/, /__theme-test/light/).

categories.SHELL: Site chrome rendered by the layout around every full-chrome page: header (with ticker and nav) and footer.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block; exactly one per page, always the first content section.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, quotes, stories, review badges.
categories.FEATURE: Product and capability explanation: splits, card grids, demos, comparison tables.
categories.COLLECTION: Repeating card lists of other content: posts, stories, guides, events, templates, roles, links.
categories.CONTENT: Long-form body content: article, story, guide chapters, report sections.
categories.CONVERSION: Calls to action and (visual-only) forms that close a page.
categories.NAVIGATION: In-page navigation controls that filter or jump within a page's content.

shell.footer.description: Global footer: wordmark + emoji rotator, four link columns, legal row, static hit counter.
shell.footer.scope: On every full-chrome route (all 59); each page renders it at the end of its own tree.

shell.header.description: Global fixed chrome: announcement ticker + main nav with mega-menus; identical on every site-layout page, themed only.
shell.header.scope: On every full-chrome route (all 59); rendered once by the site shell layout, not by pages.
